% Pattern: proof/attach/head. A font command that holds the whole head, as
% \begin{proof}[\textbf{Proof of Theorem 2.}], still names what the proof
% proves. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=none
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 2 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=theorem-2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\begin{theorem} Every finite space is compact. \end{theorem}
\section{Proofs of the main results}
In this section we prove the theorems above.
\begin{proof}[\textbf{Proof of Theorem 2.}]
Take a finite cover.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
